report.explanation: All observed checkout requests returned 200 with 63-94ms durations; logs show INFO/ok and metrics show zero 502s and p95 ~98ms on /v1/checkout. No fault is established by current evidence, and historical references are advisory only. Operator hypotheses (pool exhaustion, redis timeout, downstream latency) are not supported, so hand off for more evidence rather than assert a bounded cause.
missing_evidence: No error or latency anomaly is observed; need evidence of an actual fault (e.g., 5xx, timeouts, elevated p95) before attributing a root cause.
Need per-dependency latency/error metrics for order->inventory, order->payment, order->postgresql to test downstream-latency or db-pool-exhaustion.
Need Redis operation latency/timeout metrics for inventory->redis to test redis-timeout.
Need connection pool saturation metrics (wait time, active vs max) to test db-pool-exhaustion.
Need deployment/version change records to test bad-configuration or deployment-caused latency.
